sources.title: Marxist-Leninist/AGILLM4.3: AGILLM 4.3: 4.2 warm-started - GitHub
sources.snippet: AGILLM 4.3 AGILLM 4.3 is the AGILLM 4.2 warm start with shared MoE experts and DiffusionBlocks training. The compatibility runtime file is still named agillm41.py, but this repo tracks the 4.3 runtime and public volunteer path.

sources.title: AGILLM 4.3 EGGROLL Experimental - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository is an experimental, default-off extension of AGILLM 4.3. It adds a PyTorch EGGROLL-style evolution-strategy sidecar for the model's discrete top-1 Mixture-of-Experts routers while preserving the existing backpropagation and DiffusionBlock training path.
